title: Hospital readmission
summary: A TF-IDF baseline misses its expected AUROC, so the researcher switches to PubMedBERT embeddings at step 4. Comes with a paper that overstates the results, for Check claims.

title: AlphaFold
summary: A simulated mid-2020 session: the AlphaFold 1 pipeline stalls at GDT_TS 61.2 on T1024, and the team switches to an end-to-end Evoformer with Invariant Point Attention.
